page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at top, with the printed page number at the top right. Line numbers in the left margin at every fifth line. Below the first paragraph, a four-column table of gemstone names (Vatablus, Iunius, Brugthonus, Danæus). Then the closing paragraph of the page. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left.

main_text.l: turalis. Naturalis est partim in culinâ, partim in medicinâ:
supernaturalis, in significando mysteria, vt quod nul-
lum sacrificium debuit offerri sine sale Leuit. 2. v. 13. Marc. 9.
v. 49. quod apostoli appellantur sal terrae. Matth. 5. verf. 13.
quod sermo nostrer debet esse conditus sale Coloss. 4. v. 6.
quod denique debemus in nobis ipsis habere salem, ita vt
igne saliamur. Marc. 9. v. 49. 50.
V. Lapidum vulgarium & pretiosorum men-
tio fit in sacris. Ex lapidibus vulgaribus frequenter fit
mentio lapidum, quorum vsus est in aedificiis: item petrae,
silicis, marmoris & arenae. Ex lapidibus pretiosis cele-
brantur margaritae, & XII. gemmae Exod. 28. de quibus
infra in Lithologia. Quia vero interpretes variant in red-
dendis nominibus Hebraicis istarum gemmarum, ali-
quot sententias breviter commemorabo.

Hic solent quaerere, quid sit bdellium Gen. 2. verf. 12.
Resp. Alij volunt esse iaspidem: alij carbunculum: alij al-
bum quendam lapidem: alij arborem, quae Arabibus di-
catur etiamnum hodie Bdolchon: alij denique margari-
tam praestantissimam. Cui postremae sententiae vt astipu-
ler facit collatio huius loci Gen. 2. cum Exod. 16. v. 14. 15.

page.notes: Printed "vsus", "aedificiis" and similar spellings are as set; long s is transcribed as s. The small "vt quod" accent on quod is not clear and is written plain. The page number "83" is set in a stylised form. The running head is "BIBLICUS." with the page number at the right.
